description:
List the files stored in a micropage project (images uploaded by upload_asset, the editor or the CLI), newest first: filename, type, size, SHA-256 and upload date, plus storage used and the plan's storage limit.

Use it to see which filenames .page markup can reference with `img: <- name`, to check whether an image is already uploaded, or to check remaining storage before uploading large images.

It does not return file URLs (use get_file_url for one) or upload anything (use upload_asset). Read-only.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

name: list_files

limit_mb.description: The plan's storage limit for this project.

title: List a project's files
